## Claim amendment · file surface · #28250 · 2026-10-31T05:48Z

Amends claim 6539513940 (same session, same branch `claude/project-thread-wzzflr`). The card thread found the same label defect on other objects: `sys_audit_log` lists `record_id` as a pointer column headed "Record ID" in three views, and `sys_activity` and `sys_mail_association` carry the same label. The seat folds them into this PR wherever the console draws the pointer target (name and icon) in that cell, so the header and the cell agree; a field whose cell really shows an id keeps "Record ID".

File surface adds: the `record_id` label on `sys_audit_log`, `sys_activity` and `sys_mail_association` (each only where the cell draws the pointer target), their translation bundles and label pins. Names, queries, seeds and pointer pairs stay unchanged. Serial constraints for the added files: none known; the thread checks open PRs before pushing.
